exceptions: Visa-free entry is for tourism/social visits only; employment or paid work is prohibited.

Extensions of the Short Term Social Visit Pass may be considered for special circumstances such as illness, accident or war in the home country. Supporting evidence and a confirmed ticket to the home country or a third country are required.
